Inspection / Maintenance Item: Is the vaporizer(s) leak-free and in good working condition?
Have pilot lights been cleaned on a regular basis?
On a periodic basis, have all strainers been cleaned at the inlet side of the vaporizer(s)?
Have heavy ends been cleaned from the vaporizer(s) and/or separator tank?
Have the burner openings, thermostat, and flue been cleaned?
Is the vaporizer(s) located in accordance with NFPA 58?
